{{Top|leg}}
'''Metalwoods''' were huge [[Tree/Legends|trees]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuras III]] that grew to a height of thirty to forty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The trunk was smooth and dark gray, with metallic gray leaves. They grew where [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits were found. The tree's roots sunk into the planet's crust, tapping the ore for sustenance. The energy from the [[Kuras system/Legends|Kuras system's]] [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] allowed the tree to refine the ore and convert it into layers of bark.
